articleTitle: Time-Frequency Joint Analysis for peak power of microwave burst signal
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A method for peak power calculation for microwave burst signal is presented. The method is based on Time-Frequency Joint Analysis and software based on the method is developed. A comparison of analyzing result with that from a spectrum analyzer shows that the method can calculate the peak power of microwave burst signal accurately. The method also extracts information of peak power arriving time and corresponding frequency. The method can be applied in high peak power burst signal analysis without the request of constant duty cycle and amplitude.

articleTitle: Simplified calculation on the time performance of high efficiency frame generation algorithm in Advanced Orbiting Systems
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The high efficiency frame generation algorithm is wildly used in Advanced Orbiting Systems, so its property is important for the performance of the multiplexing mechanism. Simplified calculation methods on the average frame generation time and the average packet time delay in the high efficiency frame generation algorithm are studied. By using Erlang distribution, we get some more concise and simple calculation formulas on condition that the packet arrival rate distribution is Poisson distribution. We find that both the average frame generation time and the average packet time delay are only connected with the packet arrival rate (λ) and the number of packets in MPDU (N). Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the calculating formulas are correct. The conclusion can provide reference for engineering design.

articleTitle: A low complexity approach of chip-level MMSE equalization
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper focuses on the downlink in a CDMA based multi-user communication system experiencing frequency dependent multi-path fading. If the spreading codes are orthogonal and the channel is frequency-flat, the traditional Rake receiver is optimal. However, frequency-selective fading channels destroy the orthogonality of the spreading codes and the chip-level equalizer is proved effectively to restore the orthogonality[1]. For further improvement, the best delay is chosen to minimize the MSE. In order to reduce the computational complexity of the chip equalizer, this paper presents a novel block iterative LMMSE(B_LMMSE) algorithm. Simulations are carried in time-varying frequency-selective fading environment and show that prosed algorithm achieve great performances.

articleTitle: Measurement and analysis of power frequency magnetic field in substation of Jing-Shi Passenger Railway Line
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, on the basis of the power frequency magnetic field data measured in substation, first, the test data analysis is given, then the overall distribution characteristics of power frequency magnetic field in substation is given. Reference the judge basis(DL/T 799.7-2002) of power frequency magnetic field intensity in substation work sites, the environment of power frequency magnetic field in substation is estimated, which showed that the intensity of power frequency magnetic field is in the permission range under a special industrial environment.

articleTitle: Surface waves reduction in microstrip antennas
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper presents a survey of reducing surface waves in printed and microstrip antennas on substrates which may be electrically thick, as would be the case for printed antennas at millimeter wave frequencies. The surface wave loss is one of the well-known problems that researchers around the world are trying to overcome. This paper defines the problem and describes the main techniques proposed to reduce surface waves in MSA's.

articleTitle: Calibration on open-ended rectangular waveguide from 1GHz to 26.5GHz
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: With the development of microwave technology, near field measurement is used more and more widely. As one of key components, performance of Open-Ended Rectangular WaveGuide (OERWG) probe has the most important influence on measurement accuracy. This paper analyze the OERWG theoretically, estimating its gain. Then simulation validates the analysis. On the basis of analysis and simulation, we propose methods to calibrate OERWG probe. Taking WR284 waveguide probe as an example, the measurements are compared with simulation results. Conclusions show that, in the probe the entire frequency, gain measured value and simulation value are well matched, with biggest difference around 0.25dB, which validates the proposed calibrating method.

articleTitle: An improved model of Rayleigh fading channel with Gaussian's PSD for aeronautical En-Route scenario
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper proposes a novel model to describe Rayleigh flat fading channels with Gaussian power spectrum density featuring the aeronautical En-Route scenario. The presented method improves the Method of Exact Doppler Spread (MEDS)[1], which is one effective Sum-of-Sinusoids simulation modeling, by employing random processes to update the Doppler Frequency and Doppler Initial Phase for all individual sinusoids. It is shown the improved model can get a good convergence to the theory second-order statistics of real wireless communication channels, even if the number of the sinusoids employed is relatively small(i.e., N equals 8). The modified method helps to integrate a compact and area-efficient channel simulator on FPGA platform for the aeronautical En-Route scenario, which requires small number of sinusoids for simple and rapid implementation due to its high maximum Doppler Frequency and Gaussian power spectrum.

articleTitle: Compact spade-shaped antenna with a band-notched characteristic for UWB application
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Using spade-shaped patch and a U-shaped slot, we achieved a compact ultra-wideband (UWB) antenna with an excellence band-rejection characteristic. The measured impedance bandwidth defined by VSWR<2 of 8.0GHz (3.0–11.0GHz), with a notched band of 5.0–5.9GHz, is obtained. The proposed antenna with an overall dimension of only 38×42mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> is successfully designed and measured, showing broadband matched impedance and stable radiation patterns. A relative high gain of 4.05dBi is achieved.

articleTitle: A method to improve coupling of aperture-coupled microstrip antenna with backed substrate integrated cavity
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The coupling of aperture-coupled microstrip antenna with a backed substrate integrated cavity (SIC) is related to the SIC shape. To improve the coupling and try to reduce the size of the aperture, a method is presented in this paper by changing the shape of cavity. Due to the increase of the coupling, the bandwidth of the antenna will be enhanced with a relative smaller aperture, which is benefit for the antenna miniaturization.

articleTitle: Research on the implementation of highly efficient MIMO equalizer for LTE-A systems based on the GPP architecture
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In order to further improve the spectrum efficiency and peak data rate, uplink MIMO (multiple - input and multiple-output) has been introduced into LTEA (Release 10 and beyond). As the large dimensional MIMO increases system complexity, it is a challenge for the implementation of real-time MIMO equalizer. The massive floating-point computing power and flexible multi-core parallelism of the GPP (general purpose processor) platform make it possible to implement highly efficient MIMO equalizer. In this paper, we present our initial view on the optimization of MIMO equalizer based on the GPP platform. Furthermore, we analyze the principle of the improved matrix inversion algorithm based on Cholesky decomposition, and explain the ways to reduce computational complexity using SIMD instructions and multi-thread technology.

articleTitle: Research on performance evaluation criterion of integrated earthing system for high-speed railway
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This Paper researches the existing evaluation criterion of integrated earthing system for high-speed railway and analyzes the new problems encountered in China's rapid development according to the fact that the integrated earthing engineering has only just begun in China, which is related to the construction of high-speed railway. For these problems, presently there isn't any experience abroad, which can be used for reference. On this basis, in addition to theoretically analyzing the problems existing when the “evaluation criterion no more than 1Ω” is still used in the areas with larger earth resistivity in line with the overseas evaluation criterion on that the earthing resistance of integrated earthing system should not be greater than 1Ω and according to the characteristics of vast region and large distribution range of earth resistivity, this paper comes up with the new evaluation criterion on the field resistance of integrated earthing system through field test and verification and on the premise of ensuring that the integrated earthing system functions protectively, as well as the countermeasures against the problems of the integrated earthing system project of this stage in the areas with high earth resistivity.

articleTitle: Investigation for shielding effectiveness of metal plate
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In the paper, the shielding effectiveness of metal plate along end-fire direction is researched. The theoretical and simulation analysis of the metal plate's shielding effectiveness have been investigated. It also analyzed the relation between the height of metal plate and the shielding effectiveness. Besides, on the condition of incident plane wave, the suppressive principle and effectiveness are investigated in theory, and the theoretical analysis is tested and verified by simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Design and error analysis of a OTA for high speed pipeline ADC
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This work designs and simulates a high-speed low-power operational transconductance amplifier(OTA), which is used in a 100Msps, 8 bit pipeline ADC with 1.5 bit per stage. Primary objective of the design has been to analyze how the error of OTA (offset voltage and gain error) impact to the performance of ADC. The OTA use the circuit of fully differential telescopic cascode to get high gain and low power, it achieves 45dB voltage gain and the average offset voltage of this OTA is only 512.1uV.The ADC achieves 0.7LSB DNL and 0.9LSB INL with low power consumption from 1.8V supply.

articleTitle: Prediction and analysis of crosstalk in high speed EMUs
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Due to intensive cable arrangements in high speed emus and its vehicle equipment internal, measurement of crosstalk in the victim cable is not easy in wiring dense area. Consequently, a simple method, used to predict and analyze the crosstalk in wiring dense area is needful, to optimize cable arrangements for reducing conducted electromagnetic interference in the engineering operation. In this paper, firstly disturbance source in the culprit cable is transformed into disturbance source in the victim cable for building up voltage relationship between culprit cable and victim cable by using position function. Then crosstalk estimation formula with transmission line voltage reflection coefficient is derived in the high frequency. Thereby crosstalk voltage in victim cable is given when the disturbance source in different position of the culprit cable. After that modeling and analysis for couple of cable in high speed emus electric cabinet by electromagnetic simulation software are carried out, in order to prove the theoretical calculation results. Finally, analysis of calculation error between formula and simulation indicate that it is less than 2dB when cable terminal matched.

articleTitle: Feature extraction of shaft-rate electric field in the far field
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In the near field, the classical spectrum analysis can be used to obtain the shaft-rate frequency characteristic. But in the far field, extraction of feature information of the ship shaft-rate electric field is very difficult, because of the strong noise interference. Three methods of shaft-rate extraction are summarized. The advantages and disadvantages of above methods are analyzed.

articleTitle: The electromagnetic compatibility analysis based on a navigation system
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, the electromagnetic compatibility based on a navigation system has been studied. The EMC problems occurring in the engineering application has been focused on and the signal integrity and power integrity of the system has been simplified. In order to reduce the influence of SI, PI and EMI, a newly design scheme has been put forward, which corresponds to the acceptable simulation result. Finally, it has been proved that the system could work well through EMC test. Above all, the signal integrity analysis, power integrity analysis and EMI analysis are done with the hyperlynx software.

articleTitle: Two levels water-filling scheme for energy saving in LTE system
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Energy saving plays a significant role in the communication system. Moreover the traffics of 3GPP are expanding and getting ever more complex. We can save more energy by taking advantage of the fact that different traffics have different QoS requirements. This paper proposes a model for such kind of optimization problems. However, it is difficult to find the optimal solution. So in the view of engineering, we propose a scheme, Two Levels Water-Filling Scheme (TLWFS), to improve the energy efficiency while guaranteeing the QoS requirements. In TLWFS, firstly, we classify the traffics into two categories, which are Rate Constrained Traffic (RCT) and Rate Non-Constrained traffic (RNCT). Secondly, at the first water-filling level, the high SNR Resource Blocks (RBs) are selected to guarantee the RCT, with traditional water-filling algorithm. Finally, at the second water-filling level, the energy and RBs left are used to transfer the RNCT, with directional water-filling algorithm. Numerical results indicate that the TLWFS works well in LTE system, with the energy consumption decreased by 10% with TLWFS, compared to traditional power allocation scheme.

articleTitle: Research on BER of QPSK signal using APD statistical method
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper presents a novel statistical method to research BER of QPSK signal by using Amplitude Probability Distribution (APD). The statistical results of interfering signals, especially APD, have been widely used, and the relationship between the statistical results and performance of digital radio systems has been an open issue. The statistical method has been proved to be an effective method to study the characteristics of electromagnetic interference and it is a useful method to study the interference effect on digital communication systems. In this paper, the relation between amplitude probability distribution (APD) of interference and bit error probability (BEP) of QPSK communication signal is studied.

articleTitle: Research on the retrieval of Land Surface Temperature based on MODIS data
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Land Surface Temperature(LST) is a key parameter of the research on regional and global ground surface physical process, which synthetically reflects the result of energy and material exchange <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. In the interaction and energy exchange between land surface and atmosphere, LST is also the crucial factor of the Land Surface Energy Balance, which is affected by the Surface Radiation Balance and has important application value and plays an important significance on the ecological environment, agricultural meteorology, crop yield estimation, drought monitoring, disaster monitoring, urban environment and hydrological characteristics etc. This paper utilizes the Split-Window Algorithm and related theories to retrieve the land surface temperature of southeast coast of China based on the MODIS data. MODIS 1B data of Terra satellite at 13:19 28/09/2011 is selected. The study area is between 21.0°N ∼23.0°N and 117.0°E∼123.0°E <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup>. To begin with, the author has retrieved the atmospheric transmittance and modified its impact factors from the MODIS data. Then the author calculated the vegetation coverage through the calculating vegetation index and respectively estimated the Surface Emissivity according to the type of vegetation coverage. Finally, the LST was retrieved by adopting the Split-Window Algorithm and then the author analyzed the influence of clouds on the retrieval of LST.

articleTitle: A study on fast visualized parallel calculation of LRCS based on CUDA
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A fast algorithm of calculating LRCS of a complex target is presented and computational unified device architecture (CUDA) is used for accelerating the color-flagged Graphical Electromagnetic Computing (GRECO) method. Based on the five parameters bidirectional reflectance distribution function (BRDF) model, one target's LRCS can be divided into millions of pixels' computation which are processed on a great many of threads running in GPU. The obtained comparison of CPU calculation and CUDA parallel calculation of one aircraft shows that the speed of CUDA parallel calculation improves several times. With the help of CUDA and GRECO method, electromagnetic simulation of LRCS can be processed much more efficiently.

articleTitle: Adaptive scalable video coding for wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Video streaming is a multimedia service that gains significant development in recent years. The main problem that arises within that service is bandwidth fluctuation utilization on wireless channel network. In this paper, we propose adaptive methods of scalability as an attractive solution for the aforementioned problem. Scalable method on wireless communication must be suited to processed input/video sequence. To create adaptive scalable video coding (ASVC) method that match the QoS (Quality of Service) of video streaming service on wireless channel, we use joint scalable video model (JSVM) amendment standard. The proposed scheme has implemented on Network Simulator II (NS2) for wireless broadband network application. This new scheme is an evaluation platform for the implementation ASVC on a more realistic simulation over wireless broadband networks based on open-source program. The results show that implementation of ASVC on mode of the medium grain scalable (MGS) outperforms coarse grain scalable (CGS) mode.

articleTitle: Pruned volterra based behavioral modeling for power amplifier on outband spectra analysis
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Behavioral modeling techniques provide a convenient way to predict nonlinear response without the computational complexity of full circuit analysis for power amplifier (PA) with memory effects. A pruning approach for Volterra behavioral model is presented by introducing two control factors. It combines the called near-diagnonality algorithm and dynamic deviation reduction algorithm, then use the “OR” relationship to select the unknown Volterra kernels which are more sensitive to the output error. The structure of Volterra model can be significantly simplified without incurring loss of model fidelity. Finally, a power amplifier is employed for validation and good agreement is obtained. The pruned Volterra model is effective and flexible on outband spectra analysis of PA with strong nonlinearity and longer-term memory.

articleTitle: EM scattering by objects coated with DNM
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, bistatic RCS of objects coated with double-negative material (DNM) has been calculated by surface integral equations and MoM. The material is supposed to be homogeneous and isotropic. Based on Equivalent theory to deduce the Electric Field and Magnetic Field Integral Equation(EFIE/MFIE), then equations are translated into matrix equation by Galerkin method, equivalent electric current and magnetic current are achieved, then scattering field of coated objects can be calculated. The results of MoM for coated sphere are compared to results of Mie series analytic method. It is found that the results match well.

articleTitle: Design and investigation of a novel beam-steering cylindrical dielectric resonator antenna
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A novel beam-steering cylindrical dielectric resonator antenna (DRA) is presented in this paper. The proposed DRA consists of a cylindrical dielectric resonator with dielectric constant of 80 and two symmetrical microstrip transmission line feeding ports. It is fabricated and mounted on a grounded FR-4 microwave dielectric material. The proposed DRA is analyzed using the high frequency simulation software. The radiation pattern of the beam-steering DRA can be controlled by tuning the phase differences of the two feeding ports. When the phase difference is zero degree, the radiation pattern is directional. On the contrast, the radiation pattern is quasi omnidirectional with the phase difference of 180 degree. The resonant frequency of the DRA is about 5.5GHz, which can be tuned to 5.8GHz easily through adding a metal screw on the back of the dielectric resonator for dedicated short-range communication (DSRC).

articleTitle: Analysis of the terminal response characteristics of a single twisted-wire pair excited by HEMP
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: It is great harmful that High-altitude nuclear electromagnetic pulse (HEMP) can directly couple energy into the interior through apertures or wires. As the twist wire pair (TWP) is an important coupling way, studying the coupling of the twist wire pair excited by HEMP is very necessary in practice. The interference coupling response of the twist wire pair with the case that the incident wave is HEMP is computed by using an efficient matrix procedure based on the transmission line model (TLM). In this paper, closed-form analytic approximations of the terminal response valid for an arbitrary direction of incidence and polarization of the incoming plane-wave field are provided in the frequency. And the transient waveforms are computed by an inverse discrete Fourier transformation. Then this paper discusses what happens when a fraction of a turn is present at the end.

articleTitle: An automatic modulation classificationtechnique foraeronautical communications
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The L-band Digital Aeronautical Communication System Type-1 (L-DACS1) has been considered as the potential standard for future aeronautical communications. As an important technique for L-DACS1, Automatic Modulation Classification (AMC) can recognize and demodulate the dynamically allocated signal in the system. However, due to the interference of Distance Measure Equipment (DME), performance degradation is encountered by the existing approaches in L-DACS1. In this paper, channel estimation and equalization from L-DACS1 pilot symbols were carried out to reduce the influence of channel especially the noise, which lead to an improved classification method for L-DACS1. It is shown through simulations that the method proposed in this paper outperforms the existing algorithm which is based on the sixth-order cumulates in terms of classification accuracy and complexity for L-DACS1 in aeronautical fading channels.

Author Keywords: The L-band Digital Aeronautical Communication System Type-1 (L-DACS1)

articleTitle: Debye series of light scattering by a coated microbubble
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Debye series for plane-wave scattering by a coated microbubble is derived. Being a rigorous solution of Maxwell equations, Debye series expands the Mie scattering coefficient into an infinity series, and clarifies the physical origin of scattering. The results for various p<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub> are computed and compared. The contributions of various scattering processes to far-field scattered intensity are isolated from total scattered intensity. The effect of coating including thickness and refractive index to far-field scattered intensity is discussed.

articleTitle: A study of end to end delay over tetra packet data services based on discrete frame
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, we present packet data transmission process and analyze packet data random access mechanism with discrete frame format according to Slotted-ALOHA protocol in Terrestrial Trunked Radio (TETRA) network. A mathematical model of packet data random access is built for further simulations based on MATLAB. Given the simulations results, we achieve the performance indicator of access delay, packet data access success rate, and the average number of collisions of data packet data in TETRA network. And finally, we discuss the relative parameters that impact these performance indexes. The packet data access model and simulation conclusion proposed here have instructive significance for the design and development of TETRA network.

articleTitle: Impedance matching design of Vivaldi antenna in X-band
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The stripline design of an X-band double layer Vivaldi antenna to achieve impedance matching is described in this paper. The theory of the equivalent circuit in transmission line theory is adopted to get the wide of stripline at the coupling point, and it is deduced that the bandwidth of the antenna can be enhanced by a gradient index stripline, as well as double gain by the design of double layer. A antenna of 45mm (length) × 20mm (width) × 3.15mm (thickness) is designed and fabricated in this paper. The simulation results show that the bandwidth is from 8 GHz to 12 GHz, while the maximum gain is 6.7 dB, and the VSWR<;2, which can meet the design requirements.

articleTitle: Non-uniform triangulation technique in the shooting and bouncing ray method
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The shooting and bouncing rays (SBR) method is widely used in computing the scattering by realistically complex geometries with electrically large features. SBR employs geometrical optics (GO) ray tubes to impress physical optics (PO) surface currents through multiple bounces, which are then radiated to compute the scattered fields. The calculated GO fields are only determined by the incident wave and the geometry of the scatter. Consequently, the mesh will have no effect on the calculated GO fields, if the mesh can represent the scatter very well. Based on this principle, non-uniform triangulation technique is introduced to accelerate the scattered field calculation in the SBR method. Numerical simulations demonstrate the performance of non-uniform triangulation technique.

articleTitle: Bandwidth enhancement of multislot antenna fed by microstrip line
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: An improved wideband multislot antenna for broadband wireless applications is proposed and experimentally studied. The proposed antenna is composed of three different narrow slots and fed by a microstrip line terminated with a wide open-circuit stub. By using the combination of multislot and patch-like tuning stub, the antenna's impedance bandwidth is enhanced significantly while keeping good polarization purity within a much wider bandwidth. The antenna is studied both numerically and experimentally. It is shown that the bandwidth of the antenna is from 5.1 to 13.1 GHz, which is about 88% (for reflection coefficient |S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>| lower than -10 dB).Relatively stable radiation pattern having cross-polarization level lower than 19 dB and gain flatness of 3 dB can be achieved within the antenna's bandwidth. Owing to its wideband characteristic, it is a promising candidate for broadband communication or identification systems.

articleTitle: A method to generate pseudo-random noise with arbitrary APD
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A method was proposed for generating pseudo=random noise that meets arbitrary amplitude probability distribution (APD), which based on the direct digital frequency synthesizer (DDS) technology. It can be used as a standard source for verify APD measuring equipment or for immunity tests. The key problem is how to generate the sample value sequence and the relevant numerical processing.

articleTitle: A compact MIMO antenna used for LTE terminals with high isolation
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A compact MIMO antenna with high isolation for LTE commercial frequency band (2.57 - 2.62 GHz) is presented. The proposed MIMO antenna consists of two winding antennas with similar shape but different direction placed and each of which has the dimension of 15.5 mm ×34 mm. The separation between the two antennas is 5 mm (about 4.3% of the wavelength at 2.6 GHz). In order to achieve high isolation performance for such a small separation, an electromagnetic band gap structure is used between two antennas. It consists of an array in which each element is combined by a shaped concentric circle and via hole covered with copper on its inner surface. These elements can act as a high resistance circuit to prevent electromagnetic transmission by which to achieve a high isolation. The isolation of the proposed MIMO antenna can even reach 30 dB at the targeting frequency band.

articleTitle: QoS-guaranteed opportunistic spectrum sharing under unreliable spectrum sensing
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, we present an opportunistic spectrum sharing (OSS) scheme with quality-of-service (QoS) support for the secondary users (SUs) with non-real-time (NRT) traffic and real-time (RT) traffic in the presence of unreliable spectrum sensing in cognitive radio networks (CRNs). We also model the scheme using a 4-dimentional continuous-time Markov chain and derive spectrum sharing performance by taking the spectrum sensing errors into consideration. Our results show that the proposed scheme can improve the performance of SUs significantly and guarantee the QoS requirements of RT-SUs even under unreliable spectrum detection.

articleTitle: Recent advances in bandwidth and isolation enhancement for VHF-UHF lumped-element circulators
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Recent work on passive and active circulators for the VHF and UHF bands is described herein. Attention is given to both the optimization problem for enhanced bandwidth or isolation performance and to simulation and measurement data. For example, a passive circulator is described that has 15 dB isolation for frequencies in the 52-79 MHz band. Another passive circulator is described that has over 30 dB of isolation for frequencies in the 260-390 MHz band.

articleTitle: Design of 183GHz/325GHz dual-channel quasi-optical system
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, the of design a183 GHz/325 GHz dual-channel quasi-optical system is presented. Given the input beam waist, one can design the reflectors in each channel and we can calculate the key parameters of output beam of each reflector by using the Gaussian beam theory. A three dimensional visual software SiMatrix based on diffracted Gaussian beam analysis method (DGBA) is used to simulate the dual-channel system to evaluate the RF performance of the system. The ideal far field can be calculated from the parameters of the output beam. A commercial simulation software GRASP (based on physical optics) is used as a third party tool to verify both the design and the accuracy of simulation result by SiMatrix. By comparing the far field simulated by SiMatrix and ideal far field with the prediction using GRASP, it is found that the design meets the requirement and that the simulation results from SiMatrix is in agreement with GRASP in the mainbeam of the farfield.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of random access in LTE system
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Random access is the first step in the establishment of connection between the User Equipment (UE) and evolved NodeB (eNodeB) and it plays an important part in Long Term Evolution (LTE) communication system. First, this paper provides an overview of random access procedure. Secondly, it discusses the detailed procedure of random access based on the competition mode. On this basis, it proposes a scheme to implement on general purpose processor (GPP) platform, and the scheme meets the requirements of real-time performance effectively.

articleTitle: Research on protection coordination mechanism of railway backbone optical network
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Protection of optical network is an important research topic in railway optical transport network, and this paper constructed a reasonable network model according to the actual needs. Based on this model, it analyzed the switching processes of OMSP and SNCP which are frequently used in railway. Besides, APS signal transmission of bi-directional protection under these two protection modes was discussed, the calculation method for switching time was proposed, and actual test was carried out for the results. Meanwhile, by combining with the switching processes and “secondary switching” problems that often appear in actual test and discussion about the protection, it also proposed protection coordination mechanisms for different layers, and conducted theoretical analysis and practical verification for the results.

articleTitle: Research on near-field radiation characteristic measurement of printed dipole array
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In the paper, the electric field intensity values in near-field area are calculated using FEKO under different situations, and the calculated results are tested and verified by measured results. It is also obtained that the relation of calculated and measured results varying with the distance between measuring point and metal plate, and the distance between main-lobe direction and side-lobe direction. Besides, the both differences are less than 3dB, which meets the demand for practical engineering.

articleTitle: 107W CW SiC MESFET with 48.1% PAE
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In the paper, 30 mm high-power SiC MESFETs have been fabricated. By load-pull testing at 1.5 GHz and 48 V drain to source voltage, packaged 2×30 mm SiC MESFET transistors were demonstrated with output power higher than 107 W with 48.1% PAE, and the gain was 10.3 dB under continuous wave RF operation. Small gate periphery devices of 1 mm SiC MESFET exhibited 35 dBm output power with more than 55% PAE, and the gain was 12.3 dB under continuous wave RF operation at 1.5 GHz and 48 V drain to source voltage.

articleTitle: Analysis on the time-domain transfer characteristics of UWB TEM horn antenna
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, the time-domain field-to-circuit transfer characteristics of UWB TEM horn antenna were studied with analytical method and simulation method respectively. To obtain the electric field waveform in the far-filed region of the TEM horn excited by any voltage sources, we could first get the coupled voltage waveform of the antenna illuminated by impulse-like incident plane wave by means of experiments or simulation, and then make convolution of the coupled voltage and the excited voltage. So that rE, the field-distance product, will be acquired by multiplying the convolution result with a certain constant. It was observed that while the opening angle and azimuth angle of the TEM horn were kept unchanged, the value of rE growed larger as the length of the two conducting plates of the horn increased. If the volume of the TEM horn scaled up, the amplitude of second-time radiation pulse, resulting from mismatch between the impedance of the TEM horn and free space, stayed the same, but the delay between the second-time radiation and the main pulse increased, which equaled to 2*l/c, where l was the length of the TEM horn's conducting plate and c the speed of light.

articleTitle: An novel electromagnetic compatibility predication method based on the hardware in the loop simulation for aircraft fuel quantity indication system
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) problem of fuel quantity indication system (FQIS) seriously affects aircraft' tasks, such as flight control, air combat, navigation and command, etc. Due to the shortage of FQIS's EMC predication and verification methods, a novel EMC predication method based on hardware in the loop simulation (HILS) is presented and used for aircraft FQIS. It's ensured that electromagnetic environment (EME) and work condition of FQIS are imitated distinctly. Combined with the proposed platform, experimental verification shows that the proposed method can predicate EMC problem of FQIS quantitatively and early, and verify EMC rectification quickly and accurately. Meanwhile, the predication method has a certain value for promotion.

articleTitle: Power angle spectrum of satellite communication downlink in rainfall environment
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The rain attenuation at the single scattering approximation is calculated with Mie method. The power angle spectrum (PAS) of receive antenna on the ground under rainfall environment of satellite-to-ground communication downlink is deduced and simulated in the condition of plane wave normal incident in detail. The affection of a given rainfall environment on PAS is discussed. The study on the influence of wavelength and polarization characteristics of incident wave and the rain thickness on PAS is presented.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of interference averaging for link adaptation in LTE/LTE-A downlink
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In LTE/LTE-A system, Link Adaptation (LA) is a crucial procedure. One key factor is to have precious interference estimation considered in the LA, since the accuracy of interference estimation has a significant impact on the Channel Quality Indicator (CQI). In this paper we pay our attention to the CQI mismatch problem in Link Adaptation procedure, which is mainly caused by rapid fluctuation of inter-cell interference depending heavily on traffic load. Obvious performance loss has been observed in system level simulation due to this problem, thus we propose an interference averaging scheme for CQI calculation by considering not only the instantaneous interference level, but also the interference level in the past when UEs doing CQI calculation. Based on intensive system level simulations, it can be observed that the proposed scheme can improve the system performance both for average throughput and cell-edge throughput.

articleTitle: Research on electromagnetic compatibility testing indexes based on statistical process control
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A method analyzing EMC testing indexes is proposed based on the Statistical Process Control. Adopting this method, we firstly collect testing data accumulated in engineering practice, then recur to the statistical analyze, paint control chart, evaluate the steady state of electromagnetism characteristic and assistant decision makings about testing parameters. Differencing from the conventional applications of Statistical Process Control, we needn't discover the exceptional factors based on the feedback information or take corresponding measures to eliminate influence; Also based on the testing data analysis, this method avoids large amount of modeling and simulating numeration and is simple and convenient, which will be a great favor in complex circumstance where it is difficult or impossible to establish simulating models. To illustrate how this method be carried out in practice, we analyze the super scales of a typical electromagnetic emission item step by step, and give some advices based on the results at last.

articleTitle: A multi-region conformal MRTD scheme for modeling 3-D curved dielectric surfaces
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, a new multi-region conformal multiresolution time-domain (MR-CMRTD) scheme based on Daubechies' wavelets, which utilizes the locally conformal technology, the concept of effective dielectric constant (EDC) and multi-region decomposition technology, is proposed and applied to solve 3-D electromagnetic scattering problems for curved dielectric objects. It is numerically demonstrated that the proposed MR-CMRTD scheme can effectively solve the invalidation of Maxwell curl equations on the mutation surfaces of dielectric and reduce the staircase error.

articleTitle: The research of near-field interference characteristic of sensor in RE measurement
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This passage is to study the near-field interference characteristics of the sensor when taking the test of radiated emission. In addition to the influence on the test data from the probe factor, the sensor itself would cause interference to the electromagnetic environment around the source (taking a simplified RF integrated module for instance here)in the test. By means of HFSS simulation[1]and calculation, we will do some research on the change of the distribution of electromagnetic field and the impact on the accuracy of data acquisition due to the change in the condition whether probe is existed or not in this paper.

articleTitle: On the fast solving method of radiation fields density of phased array antenna based on the pattern multification
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The fast solving method of radiation field density of the phased array antenna based on the pattern multification is constructed. The pattern multification is extended to the solving of field density of array antenna. The power coefficient is introduced to transplate the pattern to the field density. And the producing mechanism of the power coefficient are analysed.

articleTitle: A design of OFDM signal for ground penetrating radar
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper discusses a flexible OFDM signal design for ground penetrating radar. First, the subcarriers are modulated by values of desired spectrum sequence; secondly, according to different sizes and depths of targets, the desired GPR signal spectrum is adaptively estimated using some priori knowledge of target information. The simulating results show the proposed signal design scheme for GPR performs well in detection of both thin and deep layer targets.

articleTitle: Bandwidth enhancement of small-size planar mobile device antenna using a novel parasitic element
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A internal planar mobile device antenna having a small size of 16×42mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> for the WWAN/LTE operation. The antenna comprises a wandering driven strip at the front side of the substrate and an invert F shape parasitic shorted strip at the back. The driven strip generates λ/4 and 3λ/4 resonant modes. An extra resonant at 1800MHz is obtained and the bandwidth of the driven strip's two resonant modes is enhanced by embedding the parasitic shorted strip. Owing to the contribution of the two strips, the antenna capable of two wide bands (780-1090/1700-2850 MHz) to cover the desired GSM850/900/1800/1900/UMTS/LTE2300/2500 bands for the WWAN/LTE operation. Details of the proposed antenna and its radiation performances are presented.

articleTitle: An analysis of electromagnetic coupling between array antennas
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Electromagnetic coupling between array antennas is an important area for the antenna research. In this paper, the coupling between array antennas is discussed, and the experimental device of electromagnetic diffraction coupling between two arrays is designed, as well as the diffraction coupling level data are tested and analyzed when angle between arrays changes. We found that with the changes of the angle between arrays, the received levels at different points of test decrease when the angle between arrays decreases. The minimized diffraction coupling level is obtained at the 90° between arrays.

articleTitle: Research on radiation emission limits of airborne equipment
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper introduces a method of estimating the airborne equipment radiation interference and calculating radiation emission limit. According to the uniqueness theorem of electromagnetic field, the model of the radiation source are described, which is theoretically proved that it is equivalent to the radiation source. The method is present with a practical engineering example,which establish a platform model and equivalent source model. Combined with microwave network theory and numerical simulation software, the radiation interference to the shortwave radio receiver is predicted. In order to satisfy the compatibility of shortwave radio receiver, the radiation emission limit of the interference source is calculated. Finally, the process and method of the equivalent source model of tailoring radiation emission limit is summarized; which can help the engineering set the emission limit and unsure the compatibility of the near-by airborne equipment.

articleTitle: Study of shielding properties of cylindrical enclosures illuminated by EMP
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Shielding effectiveness(SE) of cylindrical metallic enclosures with apertures illuminated by electromagnetic pulse (EMP) is investigated by the Finite integration time-domain method, combined with the PBA[4]. Three important factors including polarization direction of the incident wave, aperture shape, and aperture array are investigated in detail for their effects on SE. Some valuable conclusions are brought forward. The theoretical analysis and simulation results illustrate that the SE can be improved by selecting appropriate shapes of apertures, ensuring the longer side of apertures is not perpendicular to the polarization direction of the incident wave in the case of that these properties of the incident wave we are known. Finally, keeping the total area unaltered, dividing the single larger aperture into multiple smaller apertures, the SE will be increased.

articleTitle: Research on near field computational method for array in free space and around object
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, research on radiation near field computational method for array in free space and around electrical large size scattering object is presented. Based on array decomposition method, the results of radiation near field for large scale array are matched well with the full wave method based on commercial software. The radiation field of a small scale array around a typical object is also solved based on the array decomposition method, which presented a way to solve the radiation near field around electrical large size object for array with larger scale.

articleTitle: FOC-MUSIC method for signal parameter estimations using vector circular array
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Vector circular array (VCA) is a relatively new array configuration for signal direction and polarization estimations. The objective of this study is to find a more accurate and robust DOA and polarization estimation approach for VCA. Fourth-order cumulants based MUSIC (FOC-MUSIC) method is attractive for possible high resolution in both white and colored Gaussian noise. This paper presents a study by comparing the FOC-MUSIC with conventional MUSIC for both white and colored Gaussian noise. Through stochastic simulation and error analysis, it is found that the adopted FOC-MUSIC can achieve more accurate estimations of direction and polarization in both white and colored Gaussian noise, especially for low SNR scenarios.

articleTitle: Investigation on transient composite scattering of a target above a randomly rough surface using a multiregion model
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A multiregion model is applied to analyze transient composite scattering from a target located above a randomly rough surface. In the multiregion model, the target and center regions of the rough surface are chosen as the dominant regions and handled by time domain electric field integral equation. The electric currents on the other regions are approximately calculated based on the magnetic-field integral equation, considering the mutual coupling between different regions. Numerical results demonstrate the accuracy and high efficiency of the multiregion model.

articleTitle: A modified algorithm of Ricean Factor K estimation for L-DACS1 system
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: One deployment option for future civil air-ground broadband communication named L-band Digital Aeronautical Communications System 1 is proposed by International Civil Aviation Organization and earlier drafted by German Aerospace Research Center. Besides the serious time selective fading for channel, interference originating from Distance Measure Equipment (DME) operating in adjacent channels in L-band has a strong impact on t Ricean factor K estimation. This paper proposed a modified algorithm of Ricean Factor K estimation based on OFDM pilot and virtual sub-carrier, which mitigate the impact of interference of DME to Ricean Factor K estimation, and the algorithm improve the estimation precision of Ricean Factor K in the case of low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). The results of simulation show that performance of the algorithm is much superior to the moment-based estimation algorithm on the condition that SNR is 3dB-5dB.

articleTitle: Design of the anechoic chamber performance measurement system
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The performance of an anechoic chamber decides the application of the chamber. The measurement for a new-built anechoic chamber could provied the acceptance check, on the other hand it is convenient to have an uncertainty evaluation for the various measurement inside of the chamber. This article provides a realization plan of a system's hardware and software to achieve the performance measurement of the anechoic chamber. After simulation, adjustment and measurement to the system, it proves the design is acceptable, and it also can accurately measure the performance of anechoic chamber.

articleTitle: On the ray trace method of solving antenna radiation based on binary tree
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The ray trace method for solving reflection field based on the binary trees is presented. And the program realization is presented as well. The results prove that the new method is high efficient.

articleTitle: Research on cross-layer QoS framework and scheduling algorithm based on IEEE 802.16
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The paper mainly researches on service scheduling algorithms for IEEE 802.16. Firstly, the paper researches the QoS mechanism of MAC from two sides, the management of service flow and QoS guarantee. The improved cross layer QoS framework is proposed for the shortcomings of the existing QoS framework. Secondly, service scheduling algorithms are also one of the key parts to realize QoS. The paper mainly studies and compares the generic scheduling algorithms used in wired and wireless network. Aiming at the shortcomings of RR and MAX C/I algorithms, the improved MAX C/I algorithm is proposed to get the balance of fairness and throughput. Finally, the matlab simulation platform is constructed to evaluate the performance of the improved MAX C/I and the class-based scheduling scheme. The simulation results show that the scheme satisfies the QoS requirement of every service and improves the fairness of the users and system throughput.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic scattering from PEC object embedded between two dielectric rough interfaces
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Electromagnetic (EM) scattering from perfect electric conductor (PEC) object embedded between two rough interfaces is investigated utilizing method of moments (MoM) for both TE and TM polarizations. Theoretical formulations of EM scattering model considered in this paper is presented and the total fields and their derivatives are solved numerically by employing MoM. The rough surfaces are modeled as realizations of a Gaussian random process with the Gaussian spectrum, while the tapered incident wave is chosen to reduce the truncation error. The influences of characteristic parameters of the rough surfaces, the relative permittivity of the medium, as well as the average height between the two rough surfaces, on the bistatic scattering coefficient (BSC) are discussed.

articleTitle: The compact band-pass filter using L slot lines and enhanced air-bridge for the spurious responses suppression
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In microwave communication systems, filters with wide stopband are required to enhance the system performance. The presence of undesired spurious response is a problem for microwave filters. Many papers have proposed the second harmonic suppression method for the band-pass filters by adding additional structures, such as DGS. However, those structures are at the sacrifice of large size and higher order harmonics could not be suppressed efficiently. In this paper, we present a new method to suppress high harmonics. Through introducing the enhanced air-bridge and L slot lines, the stopband of the bandpass filter in [1] can be extended to 30GHz so that the harmonics in 5f0, 7f0 and 11f0 are all eliminated while the passband selectivity still keeps excellent. Moreover, those extra-structures do not increase the size of the filter.

articleTitle: Design of electromagnetic cloaks for visual illusion of the shielded objects
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Based on the coordinate transformation theory, the novel shrinking cloak and the rotation cloak for visual change of the shielded objects are proposed which are used to masquerade the position, shape, material and size information of the shielded object. The permeability and permittivity of the cloaks are designed. The numerical simulation results illustrate that the shielded object covered by the cloaks and the equivalent illusion object have the same electromagnetic response. In order to meet the engineering application, we used a multi-layered homogeneous anisotropic material instead of the inhomogeneous anisotropic material in the transformation region and the layer's thickness optimization is obtained through the genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: A novel loop-dipole composite unidirectional antenna for broadband wireless communications
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: A novel wideband unidirectional antenna for broadband wireless applications is proposed and investigated in detail. The antenna is composed of a grating, symmetrical dipole and a sectorized loop. The antenna and its feed network are printed on the same thin substrate mounting above a circular ground plane. The reflection coefficient (i.e. |S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>|), radiation patterns and gain of the antenna are numerically investigated. It is shown that an impedance bandwidth from 1.68 GHz to 3.53 GHz for |S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub>| lower than -10dB is obtained. The antenna has stable, unidirectional radiation pattern with average gain of 7.04 dBi within its impedance bandwidth. Because the antenna can cover the bandwidth of different wireless communication systems such as DCS-1800, IMT-2000, WLAN-2400, WiMax and LTE, it is suitable for indoor base station applications.

articleTitle: The research about the double ridge horn calibration in local EMC testing chambers Measurements and uncertainty evaluations
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The accurate measurement of 1m antenna factor (AF) is a fundamental requirement for reliable EMC testing in RE102 followed by MIL-STD-461F. The double ridge horn (one of receiving antennas required by standard) with frequency 200MHz–1GHz is hard to transfer to calibration site for measuring because of its big dimension with 69.0cm by 94.5cm opening. In order to solve the problem and reduce the risk associated with transportation as well, a suitable indirect calibration method using a transfer antenna is described in the paper. At the frequency range from 200MHz to 1GHz, several experiments have been done and the results agree well with the calibration ones with the maximum discrepancy being 2.0 dB. A detailed experimental analysis is offered for estimating all the relevant uncertainty contributions and the expanded uncertainty is 1.7dB.

articleTitle: The APD statistical analysis of the high-speed system electromagnetic noise
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the power network offline noise of high-speed railway system, and uses the MATLAB simulation analysis on its amplitude probability distribution. The results show that the characteristics of the noise mentioned in this article is consist with the theoretical model of the high-speed railway system. It can be used to study the effects of such noise on the high-speed system.

articleTitle: Closed-form expressions for modeling diffraction at printed dipole-based FSS
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper presents analytical expressions to model the diffraction of plane-waves at planar 2-D distributions of printed dipoles. In contrast to other available analytical or quasi-analytical models, this approach rigorously captures the main underlying physics and dynamic effects of the structure, leading to a very wideband analytical equivalent circuit. The accuracy of this model is verified by full-wave simulations.

articleTitle: Parameters estimation of inter-harmonic based on state space model
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The fourth order mixed cumulants(FOMC) of damped exponential model is derived, which contains an accurate damped frequency, damped factor and other information. A method of parameter estimation using state space model based on the fourth order cumulants is proposed, which can achieve damped frequency, damped factor of the joint estimation. The simulation results show that the method can effectively restrain Gaussian color noise, with superior performance.

articleTitle: The effect on radiation pattern of logarithm periods dipole antenna by feeding mode
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: An improper feeding mode of Logarithm periods dipole antenna (LPDA) may result in the asymmetry feeding on the connection pole, which would produce phase delay between the currents on the two arms of dipole, and the main lobe of the pattern would excurse away from the antenna axis. The principle of main lobe excursion and the amelioration methods for LPDA are investigated in this paper.

articleTitle: Analysis and simulation of the Crosstalk between High voltage cables and low voltage signal lines in EMU
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Aiming at the coupling problem between CRH3G EMU 25 kV High Voltage Cable and sensor cables under the train, this paper extends the basic theory of transmission line and establishes the crosstalk theoretical model for the two kinds of commonly used shielded cables. According the arrangement of sample train, the transmission line is divided into two sections for solving the problem of different length of parallel transmission lines. Firstly, the relationship between voltage and current at one point is built. Then two equivalent harassment sources of the 25 kV High Voltage Cable core and screen are proposed at the beginning of parallel wiring part. After that time domain feature of crosstalk is analyzed by using the Finite difference time domain method, thereby the fulmar of transmission line piecewise matrix is proposed. In view of the actual situation, using 1 kV Gaussian pulse modulation as excitation source of 25 kV High Voltage Cable. The results show that, under these conditions the crosstalk can not affect the normal work of sensors.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic scattering from 1-D dielectric sea surface based on second-order small slope approximation
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, electromagnetic scattering from one dimensional dielectric sea surface is investigated, for both TE and TM polarizations, employing the second-order small slope approximation (SSA-II). The second order terms of the small slope approximation method have been numerically implemented in order to obtain accurate results for a large range of slope. The sea surfaces are modeled as realizations of a Gaussian random process with the Pierson-Moskowitz spectrum, while the tapered incident wave is chosen to reduce the truncation error. The numerical results obtained by SSA-II are presented by comparison with benchmark numerical method.

articleTitle: Transient response of transmission lines with lumped circuit termination based on the TLM
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper presents a new method to solve the transient response of transmission lines with lumped circuit termination. The method divides the transient response of a transmission line into two parts, firstly we can calculate the terminal voltage response in frequency domain by transmission line theory, transformed to time domain by FFT. Then the lump circuit termination is solved by TLM by taking the voltage response as excitation source, so the total transient response is got. It provides a new idea for solution of the different load networks. The simulation results show the efficiency and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Joint design of linear transmitter and receiver for the MIMO interference channel
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Interference alignment (IA) is a powerful scheme that has emerged out of recent work in the context of the MIMO X channel. Most of the existing IA schemes are aimed to optimize the sum-capacity, the error probability, and the mean square errors (MSE) of the system, and less consider the system power efficiency. This paper proposes a new IA scheme to minimize the system transmit power under the condition of every user's MSE constraint through a joint design of linear transmitter and receiver for a K-user MIMO interference system. In order to solve our optimization problem, we employ the Lagrange function and Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions, then get the transmitter precoding and receiving filter matrices expressions by the analysis and derivation. Finally, we use a joint iterative algorithm to solve the proposed optimization problem. Simulation results verify that the provided scheme improves the power efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on describing problems of temporal interval centered synchronization within DRIS
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: As a complex and time-critical system, railway interlocking system (RIS) is vital for the safe operation of a train in station. For the next generation RIS named Distributed Railway Interlocking System (DRIS), the synchronization issue between internal devices, which means the guarantee of a well-organized cooperation, plays an important role in ensuring trains' safety running. Therefore, as a prerequisite a clear depiction of the synchronization within DRIS is essential. To that end, a temporal interval centered describing method is proposed. Firstly, considering the time shortage in UML statechart, the temporal interval is introduced to achieve the temporal extension of UML statechart. Secondly, the temporal statechart model of the DRIS is constructed with the method above. Finally, a brief analysis of the execution of internals of DRIS is given based on the constructed model, and the timeline mechanism is adopted to graphically describe the synchronization of internals of the DRIS by the relations between temporal intervals of states depicted in timeline diagram.

articleTitle: A study of transmission characteristics in a novel rectangular-shaped microshield line
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, the influence of the position of the metallic signal strips on the cutoff characteristic of dominant mode and field patterns in a novel rectangular-shaped microshield lines with dual signal lines are calculated by edge-based finite element method. The cutoff wavelength can be adjusted by changing the dimensions of the metallic signal strips as well as by adjusting their positions. Field patterns of the dominant mode and the first higher-order mode for different dimensions and the dielectric constant of dielectric substrate are also illustrated. Numerical results provide an extension to the existing design data of rectangular-shaped microshield line and are considered useful in practical applications.

Author Keywords: the cutoff wavelength of dominant mode

articleTitle: Design on the power system of EMC hardware-in-loop experiment platform
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Nowadays, EMC has become a serious problem of modern aircraft. In order to simulate and analyze complex EMC phenomenon on aircraft, we chose HILS method to build an EMC test platform. In this paper, we discussed the power system of this platform. Based on requirement analysis, we indicated that the power system should achieve following functions: supplying power for all the devices on the platform, imitating stoppages and EMC problems of real aircraft power supply system. Then we designed details for each component of the proposed system. We also carried out some functional simulation to verify the feasibility of this system.

articleTitle: Research on the monitoring technology of the BTM RF-uplink signal
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In accordance with the relative railway standards about the balise, this paper proposed a special device to monitor the transmitting quality of the BTM's uplink signal. The hardware circuits were designed based on the analysis of the receiving principle of the BTM, and the schematics was simulated and verified by using the Multisim software. Then the PCB was designed and the final prototype device was manufactured. Test and verify shows that the prototype's performance complies with the design target. The device can be used to monitor and record the BTM uplink transmission signal, and to analyze the co-channel & adjacent channel interference.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of the radiation characteristics of IRA
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, we made research on the radiation characteristics of IRA with analytical and simulation methods. According to the research results, IRAs exhibit excellent characteristic, as small VSWR at low frequency range, short oscillation time of radiation waveform, narrow main beam, high gain and ultra wide-band. Typical radiation pulse of IRA consists of two parts, namely, the pre-pulse, which share the same shape as the excitation voltage source and is generated by the backward radiation of feed arms, and the main pulse, whose time-domain shape is the differentiation of the excitation voltage. As the volume of IRA decreases, the amplitude of pre-pulse remains the same, while that of the main pluse decreases by the same proportion.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of 150W SiC internally match and power combiner at S band
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: As one of the third generation semiconductor materials, SiC has many advantages, such as high-power, high gate-drain breakdown voltage, heat stability and anti-radiation ability. So it is of high value for study and application prospect. This paper bases on 20mm SiC MESFET which is made by NEDI, through internally match circuit and power combiner technology, designs a power module. The power module output power has 150W with the gain is 9dB at S-band 2.8GHz under a pulse condition of 100us pulse width and 10% duty cycle.

articleTitle: Prediction method of near-field coupling between phase arrays based on theory of multi-ports network
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: Interference coupling between phased array elements as subject investigated, we use multi-ports net modelling based on Z matrix to simulate coupling between phased array elements and compute amplitude and phase of every element's receiving signal. The element and synthesized coupling level is educed by method of element by element and radial method, adapted to large-scale phase arrays' coupling analysis in coplanar arrangement and solving complex iterative problem by full-wave simulating method. Compared with results by MOM, the error is less than 2dB, and this method's accuracy and efficiency can suffice engineering's requirement.

articleTitle: A thin near-field RFID antenna for file managing system
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In this paper, a thin near-field RFID antenna has been proposed which is designed for a file managing system and used in closed metal filing cabinet. The antenna is circular polarization, while its working band is from 910MHz to 930MHz.The VSWR of the antenna at 925MHz is less than 1.2, and the maximum gain is 5.2dB. Indicated through the system conjunction, the antenna can meet the system to satisfy the requirements of reading 30 tags at the same time in the range of 0.1~1 meter.

articleTitle: Optimization and implementation of SCME channel model on GPP
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper presents the implementation and optimization of the SCME (Spatial Channel Model Extension) on the GPP (General Purpose Processor) platform using SSE (Streaming SIMD Extensions) instructions and multithreading technique. The SCME which is the expansion of the SCM (Spatial Channel Model) introduces the concept of “mid-paths” and can support up to 100 MHz bandwidths in 2~5 GHz frequency range. In this paper we demonstrate detailed computational analysis of the SCME. In order to reduce the latency, it is very significant to optimize the program. Three optimization methods are proposed: SSE instructions, multithreading and linear interpolation algorithm.
