SSE instructions and multithreading can solve this problem via increasing the computing parallel degree. Linear interpolation algorithm can reduce the complexity effectively by considering the effectiveness of the sampling rate. From the experiment result we can get that the SSE instructions with the help of IPP (Integrated Performance Primitives) library function can reduce the delay to 1/5 when operating in 32-bit floating-point, multithreading can reduce the delay to 2/5, meanwhile linear interpolation algorithm can reduce the delay to 1/20 with large amount data and ration of linear interpolation L=512. When the three optimization methods are utilized simultaneously, the delay can be cut off remarkably compared with no optimization method utilized.

articleTitle: The performance of typical non-real-time scheduling mechanisms in wireless communication system
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This article discusses characteristics, performance of the scheduling algorithm in the resource allocation. The background of the study of frequency resource allocation algorithm is in free space, ideal channel estimation of the wireless network environment, considering the location information of users (i.e. the channel conditions of the user, etc.). This article does the research through modeling, the theoretical analysis of the calculation and simulating the real network environment. In addition, this article analyzes, describes and compares the typical resource allocation algorithms, and describes the improved algorithm. The main algorithms include Round Robin (RR), Maximum Signal to Noise ratio(Max S / N), Proportional Fairness (PF).

articleTitle: Overview of received signal strength based fingerprinting localization in indoor wireless LAN environments
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: In recent years, indoor localization technique is anticipated to play an increasingly important role in our society. In general, the indoor localization techniques include trilateral, triangulation and fingerprinting localization. As an important alternative, fingerprinting localization techniques are extensively studied and applied in the existing localization systems. This paper presents an overview of the fingerprinting localization system based on the received signal strength (RSS) in indoor wireless LAN (WLAN) environments. In particular, we describe the structure of localization system and then analyze the challenges that most existing research works try to deal with. Corresponding solutions and several pattern matching algorithms are also presented. Furthermore, we demonstrate a comparative study of existing fingerprinting localization systems and address the possible directions of future research in indoor localization techniques.

articleTitle: Intelligent tuning for microwave filters based on multi-kernel machine learning model
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: This paper presents an intelligent alignment method for the automatic tuning device of microwave filters. In the method, a model that reveals the relationships between the tunable screws and filter electrical performance is firstly developed by using an improved machine learning algorithm which can incorporate multi-kernel into the traditional linear programming support vector regression to improve the modeling accuracy. Then, a tuning procedure of filters is constructed by using the developed machine-learning model. Finally, some experiments are carried out, and the experimental results confirm the effectiveness of the method. The approach is particularly suited to the computer-aided tuning devices or an automatic tuning robot of volume-producing filters.

articleTitle: Dynamic cell clustering for CoMP in LTE-A and its calibrated system level performance evaluation
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: With the rapid growing demand on high data-rate and high-quality wireless services, a large dimension of multicell cooperative transmission has shown prosperous in next generation wireless communication systems including long-term evolution (LTE) and its advanced (LTE-A). Effective investigations on multicell cooperation extraordinarily rely on the availability of a system level simulator. In this work, we first present fundamental instructions on constructing a system level simulator for LTE. The calibration outputs of our simulator show its effectiveness and consistency with widely-acknowledged standard requirements. Then, the simulator is further enhanced for supporting multicell cooperation, i.e., coordinated multi-point transmission (CoMP) in LTE/LTE-A. With the enhanced calibrated simulator, we propose a dynamic cooperating cell clustering strategy for suppressing the inter-cell interference (ICI) while maintaining low cooperating overhead. System level performance evaluated by our simulator shows that the dynamic clustering outperforms existing approaches in terms of both large scale cell average throughput and cell-edge user performance.

articleTitle: Base station energy saving based on dynamic programming combined with cell clustering
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: With continuous growth of the wireless cellular networks, the network operators take the energy-efficiency into their consideration as a major design goal lately. It also receives a growing number of attentions from engineers and researchers, due to the increasing awareness of environmental and economic issues. In this paper, we develop a theoretical framework for base station (BS) energy saving that encompasses cell clustering and dynamic BS sleeping operation. The combination of these two aspects allows for a more flexible and accessible tradeoff between cellular networks performance and energy consumption. Our clustering strategy based on the geographic information and traffic load is able to degrade the overall scale of this problem. Moreover, the BS sleeping policy could be found quickly by the dynamic programming (DP) algorithm with a state-reduced solution space based on the distances between BSs and the utilizations of BSs. Specifically, we minimize the total cost of the whole network as much as possible with a low complexity of the algorithm and little additional signaling, thus our policy is easy to implement in practice. The simulation results under practical configurations demonstrate that the proposed dynamic algorithms can effectively reduce energy consumption at a low complexity.

articleTitle: Research on theory and technologies of scale model simulation of microwave landing system
publicationTitle: 2013 5th IEEE International Symposium on Microwave, Antenna, Propagation and EMC Technologies for Wireless Communications
abstract: The airport site environmental influence is one important factor to reduce the navigation precision of the microwave landing system (MLS). According to the technology system and navigation principle of MLS, the scheme of hardware-in-the-loop simulation of MLS based on scale model with large scale factor was put forward. We used the controllable laser transmitting equipment to simulate the function of the angle navigation antenna of the MLS, radiating well directional laser scanning beam. According to the electromagnetic similitude theory, we set up the scale model of the environment of an airport, and used the propagation of the laser in the scale model of the airport to simulate the real propagation situation of the navigation signal transmitted by the MLS. The feasibility of this simulation system was analyzed thoroughly. The critical technologies of this system had been researched. At last, the scale model of one real airport was set up; the scale model simulation was conducted. The simulation results indicated the validity of the scale model simulation system of MLS.
